# Events

Every event the runtime routes, named by the listeners that subscribe to it.

## `Semitexa\Authorization\Domain\Event\AuthorizationDenied`

Listeners:

- `Semitexa\Authorization\Pipeline\AuthorizationAuditListener`

## `Semitexa\Core\Event\HandlerCompleted`

Listeners:

- `Semitexa\Ssr\Application\Service\Async\HandlerCompletedListener`

## `Semitexa\Modules\EventsDemo\Domain\Event\UserSignedUp`

Listeners:

- `Semitexa\Modules\EventsDemo\Application\Handler\DomainListener\AnnounceSignupListener`
- `Semitexa\Modules\EventsDemo\Application\Handler\DomainListener\AwardWelcomeBadgeListener`
- `Semitexa\Modules\EventsDemo\Application\Handler\DomainListener\SendWelcomeMailListener`

## `Semitexa\Orm\Domain\Event\ResourceChangedEvent`

Listeners:

- `Semitexa\Cms\Application\Service\SiteMapRefreshListener`
- `Semitexa\Ssr\Application\Service\Async\ResourceInvalidationPublisher`

## `Semitexa\Tenancy\Domain\Event\TenantResolved`

Listeners:

- `Semitexa\Locale\Application\Handler\DomainListener\TenantResolvedLocaleListener`
- `Semitexa\Orm\Application\Handler\DomainListener\TenantResolvedConnectionListener`
